<documents>
<document id="support-complaints">
MakingˆaˆcomplaintˆIfˆyou'reˆunhappyˆwithˆsomethingˆwe'veˆdone,ˆtellˆus.ˆYouˆcanˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaintˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆcomplainˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆsayˆyou'dˆlikeˆtoˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaint.ˆTellˆusˆwhatˆhappenedˆandˆwhatˆyou'dˆlikeˆusˆtoˆdo.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆitˆtoˆourˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆ-ˆWeˆacknowledgeˆyourˆcomplaintˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ-ˆWeˆsendˆaˆfinalˆresponseˆwithinˆ15ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆmoreˆtime,ˆforˆexampleˆbecauseˆwe'reˆwaitingˆonˆanotherˆbank,ˆwe'llˆtellˆyouˆwhyˆandˆwhenˆtoˆexpectˆanˆanswer.ˆ##ˆOurˆresponseˆTheˆfinalˆresponseˆexplainsˆwhatˆweˆfound,ˆwhatˆwe'llˆdo,ˆandˆyourˆoptionsˆifˆyou'reˆstillˆunhappy,ˆincludingˆwhereˆyouˆcanˆtakeˆyourˆcomplaintˆoutsideˆTallowbrook.ˆ##ˆLegalˆmattersˆIfˆyourˆmessageˆinvolvesˆlegalˆactionˆorˆaˆregulator,ˆsupportˆpassesˆitˆstraightˆtoˆtheˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆMakingˆaˆcomplaintˆneverˆaffectsˆhowˆweˆtreatˆyourˆaccount.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="docs-account-details">
FindingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆYourˆroutingˆnumberˆandˆaccountˆnumberˆareˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails.ˆYou'llˆneedˆthemˆforˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆtoˆlinkˆTallowbrookˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆorˆtoˆreceiveˆaˆwire.ˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆfindˆthemˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆAccountˆdetails.ˆTapˆtheˆeyeˆiconˆtoˆshowˆtheˆfullˆaccountˆnumber.ˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆit'sˆyouˆfirst.ˆ##ˆCardˆnumberˆversusˆaccountˆnumberˆYourˆcardˆnumberˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆnumber.ˆDon'tˆgiveˆyourˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆanˆemployerˆforˆdirectˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆKeepingˆthemˆsafeˆOnlyˆgiveˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆtoˆpeopleˆandˆcompaniesˆyouˆtrust,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployer.ˆSomeoneˆwithˆtheseˆnumbersˆcanˆtryˆtoˆpullˆmoneyˆbyˆACH.ˆIfˆthatˆhappens,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆit.ˆ##ˆSupportˆwon'tˆreadˆthemˆoutˆForˆsecurity,ˆsupportˆwon'tˆreadˆyourˆfullˆaccountˆnumberˆorˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆyouˆinˆchatˆorˆonˆtheˆphone.ˆYouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆthemˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆWireˆinstructionsˆForˆincomingˆwires,ˆuseˆtheˆWireˆinstructionsˆscreenˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆwhichˆalsoˆshowsˆourˆSWIFTˆcodeˆforˆinternationalˆwires.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="support-power-of-attorney">
PowerˆofˆattorneyˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆpowerˆofˆattorneyˆforˆaˆTallowbrookˆmember,ˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteamˆcanˆaddˆyouˆtoˆtheirˆaccountˆasˆanˆagent.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆneedˆ-ˆAˆcopyˆofˆtheˆpowerˆofˆattorneyˆdocument,ˆsignedˆandˆinˆeffectˆ-ˆYourˆgovernment-issuedˆphotoˆIDˆ-ˆYourˆcontactˆdetailsˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆsendˆitˆEmailˆsupport@tallowbrook.exampleˆwithˆtheˆsubjectˆPowerˆofˆattorney,ˆorˆaskˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆtoˆmessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheirˆsession.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆreviewˆtheˆdocuments.ˆTheyˆgoˆtoˆAccountˆServices.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆAccountˆServicesˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdaysˆtoˆconfirmˆwhatˆtheyˆreceived,ˆandˆmayˆaskˆforˆmoreˆinformation.ˆ##ˆUntilˆit'sˆapprovedˆWeˆcan'tˆshareˆinformationˆorˆtakeˆinstructionsˆfromˆyouˆuntilˆAccountˆServicesˆhasˆapprovedˆtheˆdocument.ˆThatˆincludesˆfreezingˆcardsˆorˆchangingˆplans.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆisˆinˆdangerˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆisˆbeingˆexploitedˆfinancially,ˆtellˆus.ˆWeˆtreatˆthatˆasˆurgent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
